title: Llama dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <rect x='33' y='62' width='7' height='26' rx='3' fill='#f2e2c4' transform='rotate(12 36 75)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='7' height='26' rx='3' fill='#e6d2ac' transform='rotate(-14 62 75)'/>
  <rect x='40' y='64' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#e6d2ac' transform='rotate(-10 44 76)'/>
  <rect x='51' y='64' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#f2e2c4' transform='rotate(10 54 76)'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a97b4f'/>
  <rect x='66' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a97b4f'/>
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8f653f'/>
  <rect x='54' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8f653f'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#ffe7b3'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='4' fill='#f7dfb0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M40 48 Q36 34 42 24 L48 26 Q44 36 47 48 Z' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <path d='M44 46 Q42 34 46 26' stroke='#ffe7b3' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='20' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M40 15 L37 8 L42 13 Z' fill='#f7dfb0'/>
  <path d='M49 15 L52 8 L47 13 Z' fill='#f7dfb0'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='21' r='1' fill='#c98a5a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='19' r='1.1' fill='#5a3b2e'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='19' r='1.2' fill='#5a3b2e'/>
  <!-- raised dancing arms (front legs lifted) -->
  <rect x='30' y='46' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#fff3d6' transform='rotate(-30 33 53)'/>
  <rect x='64' y='46' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#fff3d6' transform='rotate(28 67 53)'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#ffe7b3'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#ffe7b3'/>
  <!-- little music notes -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='26' r='2.4' fill='#ff7ab8'/>
  <rect x='21.6' y='16' width='1.6' height='10' fill='#ff7ab8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='2.4' fill='#7ad8ff'/>
  <rect x='79.6' y='10' width='1.6' height='10' fill='#7ad8ff'/>
</svg>
